cardName: The American Express® Corporate Gold Card

benefit.benefitDesc: You could enjoy an in-flight meal or refreshment at your leisure. You could even get flight change fees covered on your next business trip. Simply select one qualifying airline before booking to receive up to $100 in statement credits per calendar year when incidental fees such as these are charged by the airline to your Corporate Gold Card account.

Can provide coverage for lost, damaged or stolen Baggage when traveling on a Common Carrier Vehicle (e.g. plane, train, ship or bus) when the Entire Fare has been charged to your Eligible Card. Coverage limits apply.

From selecting the perfect restaurant for your client dinner to arranging your ride to the airport to securing tickets for client entertainment, Corporate Platinum Card Concierge® can assist with the little details that make a big difference.

Make business rides with Uber or make orders through Uber Eats to earn Uber Cash back. Corporate Gold Card Members enrolled in the Uber benefit can earn 5% Uber Cash on eligible rides with Uber and orders with Uber Eats when you book them through your business profile and charge them to your Corporate Gold Card. You can use Uber Cash for personal rides with Uber and orders with Uber Eats in the U.S.

benefit.benefitTitle: Fee Credit for Global Entry or TSA PreCheck®
benefit.benefitDesc: Receive either a $120 statement credit for Global Entry or a statement credit for up to $85 for TSA PreCheck® (through a TSA PreCheck official enrollment provider) for a 5-year plan.

Global Assist Hotline is available to you 24/7. We can help you prepare for your trip before you go – with important information specific to your destination. While you’re traveling more than 100 miles from your home in the United States, coordination and assistance with services such as lost passport replacement assistance, translation services, missing luggage assistance, and emergency legal and medical referrals are only a phone call away.

Give your employees something that will help make their travel experience easier and more rewarding. Corporate Green and Gold Card Members receive complimentary Hilton HonorsTM Silver status. With Hilton Honors Silver Status, Card Members will receive up to 10 Base Points per $1 spent on eligible stays at Hilton, plus a Bonus on all Base Points earned, getting them to free nights for personal travel faster.
